original_input.approval_comment: Approved. The facilitation-only structuring is the right first roadmap milestone — please make sure Requirements calls it out as a hard blocker for everything else, not just a risk.

problem_statement.summary: Regional UK producers/distributors face wholesaler consolidation and lack compliance infrastructure buyers require, losing contracts despite quality.
problem_statement.reasoning: Carried forward verbatim from idea_brief_items.problem_statement — no drift.

target_users.summary: Independent UK producers/distributors without in-house compliance, and HORECA buyers wanting traceable, local ingredients with compliance evidence.
target_users.reasoning: Condensed from idea_brief_items.target_users (TU-01, TU-02) without dropping either.

value_proposition.summary: HarvestLink gives producers a compliance/traceability layer plus direct buyer discovery -- winning contracts without an in-house compliance team.
value_proposition.reasoning: Carried forward verbatim from idea_brief_items.value_proposition — no drift.

market_context.summary: No competitor combines producer-friendly market access with compliance tooling -- the gap targeted; threat is a wholesaler bundling this first.
market_context.reasoning: Condenses market_analysis_items' SWOT into the single most decision-relevant insight.

constraint_summaries.mitigation_summary: Operate strictly as a data/matching and documentation layer; producers and distributors remain the FBOs, HarvestLink never takes physical possession of food.
Require producer and distributor dual sign-off on every traceability record, with an immutable audit log.
Require producer attestation and sign-off before any allergen declaration is finalised on-platform.

north_star_metrics.metric: Time from producer onboarding to first fully-documented, compliance-complete trade
north_star_metrics.reasoning: Carried from idea_brief_items' candidate_success_metrics (SM-01), resolved to a concrete target.

north_star_metrics.metric: Compliance-documentation completeness score at first trade
north_star_metrics.reasoning: Carried from idea_brief_items' candidate_success_metrics (SM-02), resolved to a concrete target.

roadmap.title: Structure the platform as facilitation-only
roadmap.description_summary: Legal/product design validated with a design partner -- resolves Food-Business-Operator gap (CON-01); nothing later proceeds without this being right.

roadmap.title: Design and validate dual-sign-off traceability and allergen-declaration workflows
roadmap.description_summary: The Amber mitigations (CON-02, CON-03) must be built and tested with real producer/distributor data before onboarding opens beyond a pilot cohort.

roadmap.title: Pilot launch with capped cohort and completeness-scaled transaction limits
roadmap.description_summary: Then widen limits as completeness data accumulates.

open_risks.description_summary: Facilitation-only structuring risk: the roadmap depends on this structure; no fallback defined if it cannot fully avoid FBO status.
Compliance-documentation-completeness methodology: dual-sign-off and scoring is a design commitment, not a validated methodology yet.
Competitive response speed: a wholesaler could bundle a producer-marketplace feature into existing compliance infra before pilot launch.

executive_summary.summary: HarvestLink connects UK producers to foodservice buyers via compliance tooling no competitor offers; facilitation-only design is the top open risk.
executive_summary.reasoning: Every sentence condenses a claim already present elsewhere — no new claim introduced. Written last.

functional_requirements.title: Facilitation-only role attestation at onboarding
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall require every onboarding producer or distributor to explicitly attest that they, not HarvestLink, hold Food Business Operator status for any trade facilitated on the platform.
functional_requirements.reasoning: Directly restates CON-01's mitigation_summary as a testable onboarding step.

functional_requirements.title: Foodservice buyer discovery and matching
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall allow foodservice buyers to discover onboarded producers and distributors by product category, location, and compliance-documentation completeness score.
functional_requirements.reasoning: The value proposition names 'direct buyer discovery' explicitly.

functional_requirements.title: Dual sign-off traceability record entry
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall require both producer and distributor sign-off before a traceability record is finalised, and shall retain every finalised record in an immutable, append-only audit log.
functional_requirements.traces_to: vision.md § Regulatory Posture (traceability mitigation: producer and distributor dual sign-off, immutable audit log)

functional_requirements.title: Producer-attested allergen declaration workflow
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall require producer attestation and sign-off before an allergen declaration is finalised on-platform.
functional_requirements.traces_to: vision.md § Regulatory Posture (allergen mitigation: producer attestation and sign-off before finalisation)

functional_requirements.title: Compliance-completeness-scaled transaction limits
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall set a producer's maximum transaction value according to their compliance-documentation completeness score, and re-evaluate that limit as the score changes.
functional_requirements.notes: Split from Roadmap Phase 3's compound clause — see compound_splits
functional_requirements.reasoning: Half of Phase 3's compound clause, independently testable from FR-007.

functional_requirements.title: Facilitation-only transaction routing
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall never record HarvestLink as taking possession, title, or physical custody of food in any transaction; every trade shall be routed and documented as a direct producer/distributor-to-buyer arrangement.
functional_requirements.traces_to: vision.md § Regulatory Posture (FBO-status mitigation: HarvestLink never takes physical possession of food)
functional_requirements.reasoning: Restates CON-01's mitigation from the transaction-routing angle.

functional_requirements.title: Pilot-phase cohort restriction
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall restrict onboarding and trading, during the pilot phase, to a cohort of producers/distributors explicitly designated eligible by the product/operations team.
functional_requirements.notes: Split from Roadmap Phase 3's compound clause — see compound_splits
functional_requirements.reasoning: The other half of Phase 3's compound clause, independently testable from FR-005.

functional_requirements.title: Time-to-first-compliant-trade measurement
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall record, per producer, the elapsed time from onboarding start to first fully-documented, compliance-complete trade, and expose this for reporting against a target of under 14 days.
functional_requirements.reasoning: Directly restates NSM-01's metric and target.

functional_requirements.title: Compliance-documentation-completeness measurement
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall record, per producer, a compliance-documentation completeness score at first trade, and expose this for reporting against a target of at least 95%.
functional_requirements.reasoning: Directly restates NSM-02's metric and target.

assumptions.short_title: Facilitation-only structure will hold up to validation
assumptions.summary: Vision's facilitation-only legal/product structure hasn't been validated yet, though FR-001/FR-006 assume it will hold.
assumptions.reasoning: vision.md's Roadmap calls for validating this structure, but that hasn't happened yet — FR-001/FR-006 are written as if it already holds.

assumptions.short_title: Producers and distributors have sufficient digital access
assumptions.summary: Attestation, dual sign-off, and allergen declaration all assume reliable on-platform digital access.
assumptions.reasoning: None of the three FRs' digital workflows were validated against the target segment's actual access.

assumptions.short_title: Buyers will trust the displayed completeness score without independent audit
assumptions.summary: Buyer discovery assumes foodservice buyers will act on the completeness score directly.
assumptions.reasoning: Nothing in vision.md or requirements.md confirms buyers will accept the score without their own audit.

assumptions.short_title: Pilot cohort will be selected and onboarded manually
assumptions.summary: The cohort-eligibility gate assumes manual designation by product/operations.
assumptions.reasoning: FR-007 never specifies a self-service application flow, so manual designation is the working assumption.

constraints.reasoning: Carried forward from vision.md § Regulatory Posture's Red CON-01 item.

constraints.short_title: Allergen declarations require producer attestation before finalisation

constraints.reasoning: Carried forward from vision.md § Roadmap Outline, Phase 3.
